Author: Serpens66
Name: AI Defense
Description: Keeps AI castle towers garrisoned with targetable ranged defenders held in private, neutral tribes outside normal AI command groups and troop categories.

Changes: Keeps AI Defense fully inactive in the map editor by rejecting editor-map loads and guarding scans, defender tracking, tribe interception, and movement-order interception.
Use the one-based unit and building IDs returned by Script Extender 1.41 queries directly without applying a second offset.
Pass named owner and sprite-color arguments when spawning tower defenders.
Allow automatic unit and private-tribe movement orders whose destination belongs to the defender's own tower while continuing to block destinations outside it.
Keep the Hold stance so ranged defenders can reposition for line of sight without pursuing enemies away from their tower.
Remove the redundant animal-specific SetAttackNearestUnit(false) call.
Add timestamped Info diagnostics and summary counters for allowed on-tower movement orders.
Assign protected defenders the signed AI behaviour sentinel -1 so they remain outside all known Defense, Patrol, attack, and siege troop buckets instead of appearing unclassified as type 0.
Correct Script Extender query results from zero-based array indices to one-based game IDs before unit and building access.
Rename role and category diagnostics to AI behaviour type and related-value terminology based on runtime evidence.
Retain private tribes and all movement, target-order, assignment, and recovery hooks as safety fallbacks.
Add aggregate diagnostics for AI combat-unit roles, related category values, tribe membership, neighboring raw AI fields, and the player army counter.
Include target tribe state, owner, stance, group size, patrol mode, and attack-nearest state in blocked assignment diagnostics.
Throttle repeated assignment and classification-reset diagnostics after the first three occurrences.
Assign every protected tower defender once to its own neutral private tribe instead of repeatedly blocking normal AI assignment attempts.
Validate private tribes by both local and global ID and automatically recover deleted or stale tribes.
Block movement and target orders addressed to private tribes while retaining direct unit movement protection as a fallback.
Add timestamped Info diagnostics for private tribe creation, recovery, orders, and failures.
Keep spawned defenders selectable and targetable by removing the global Script Extender selectability filter.
Reset protected defenders to the neutral AI behavior category and tribe role whenever the AI tries to classify them.
Add timestamped Info diagnostics for AI behavior category and tribe role resets.
Add automatic AI tower garrison checks and protected archer spawning.
Prevent spawned tower defenders from being assigned to AI tribes or receiving direct movement orders.
Add timestamped Info diagnostics for tower scans, spawning, blocked orders, deaths, and cleanup.
